# Lessons Learned: High-Resolution SVG Injection
- Date: 2026-05-29 - Challenge: Scaling 256x256 base64 PNGs via CSS `background-size` causes interpolation blur. Embedding 8MB ultra-high-res base64 payloads bloats the DOM/UI thread. - Resolution: Dynamic downsampling via Python PIL. Use Lanczos resampling to scale the canonical master asset to the exact intrinsic dimensions of the SVG wrapper. - Execution: `generate_crisp_svgs.py` reads `canonical_about_logo.png`, shrinks it to 800x800, encodes to base64, and wraps it in `<svg> <image width="800" height="800" .../> </svg>`. - CSS Overrides: Adjust layout CSS to `background-size: contain` and specific dimensions to prevent standard CSS cropping of the 800x800 intrinsic SVG. - Rule: Do not rely on browser CSS scaling for base64 raster embeddings in SVGs. Downsample the canonical asset before base64 encoding.
